subtitle: Edit a mod, then play with it. Your original game files are kept safe.
edit_hint: Follow the steps below. Start by choosing a .pak file.
no_paks: Not set up yet. Click Set Up Manager to get started.
edit_instructions: Unpack the selected PAK, then edit its files.
edit_note: Change existing values only. Do not rename or delete game files.
build_instructions: Build your edited PAK, then add it to your mods.
play_hint: Start the game with your saved mods, or restore the original files.
play_step1: 1. Build and add your mod on the first tab.
play_step2: 2. Click Play With Mods. Wait until the status says the launcher is ready.
play_step3: 3. Press Play in the Evolve launcher that opens.
play_after: When finished, close the game and launcher. Then click Restore Game Files.
settings_hint: Click Set Up Manager once. Advanced users can select existing folders below.
filter_label: Only unpack files with this name (optional):
advanced_limit: Advanced: this tool edits existing PAK entries. Some binary file types need separate tools.
status_welcome: Ready. Set up the manager or choose a PAK.
editor_hint: Choose a file on the left. Ctrl+F searches inside it.
editor_footer: Save your file here, then click Build Mod in the main window.
dialog_build_body: Your mod file is ready. Click Add Mod to use it in game.
dialog_added_body: Mod added. Go to Play & Restore?
dialog_play_body:
This opens the Evolve launcher with your mods. Wait until the launcher is ready before pressing Play.

Use only for private/offline testing. Continue?
dialog_restore_body:
Close Evolve and its launcher first. Your original files will be restored, and mods kept ready for next time.

Continue?
dialog_export_body:
This includes prepared PAKs, signing resources, projects, and the app. The ZIP may be very large.

Close the game and restore its files first. Continue?
setup_question_body:
This creates mod-ready PAKs, signing keys and a matching injector from your installed Evolve game.
Choose your game folder and client. Your original files will not be changed.

Already set up? Choose No, then select the existing folders in Settings.
setup_complete_body:
Your PAKs, signing keys and matching injector were created from this installation.

Select a PAK on Make a Mod to begin.
old_backups_body: A previous mod launch may not have finished restoring your game. Close the game and client, then use Restore Game Files in the previous manager or its restoration helper. No files were changed.
old_partial_body: A partially prepared mod file exists. Use the previous manager to inspect or recover it before setting up again. No files were changed.
old_ready_body:
Found {count} prepared mod file(s) from an earlier setup.

You can preserve them by renaming them in place, then continue creating a fresh setup. This does not change installed PAKs, but the earlier manager will need to prepare its mod files again if you return to it.

Preserve the old prepared files and continue?
old_ready_complete: Saved {count} previously prepared mod file(s) alongside your installation. Their original names are recorded in Data/ArchivedPrepared.
editor_files_help: Edit text and XML files; use Ctrl+S to save.
editor_images_help: DDS previews and imports; PNG conversion supports DXT1/3/5 and BC5.
editor_models_help: Native export and experimental same-layout import.
editor_select_file: Choose an item on the left.
batch_help: Ctrl/Shift-click to select multiple PAKs. Batch extraction keeps each archive in its own editable workspace.
credits_website_label: Modded Evolve website (install Evolve Stage 2 here)
credits_install_note: Install Evolve Stage 2 through the Modded Evolve website before using this manager. The mod manager does not install the game.
editor_archive_selector: Unpacked PAKs — select an archive below to browse its files (Build Mod works on one PAK at a time)
